dedupe_keys.name: stationnement reglemente pour les personnes a mobilite reduite dans la commune de caluire et cuire

description: Stationnement réglementé pour les Personnes à Mobilité Réduite dans la commune de Caluire-et-Cuire is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Caluire-et-Cuire. The possibility of parking on roads or in car parks, public or private, helps to ensure the accessibility of motorized travel for people with disabilities and people with reduced mobility (PRM). A legal framework exists to guarantee this right. Coverage: Caluire-et-Cuire. The portal shows the English title as "Regulated parking for people with reduced mobility in the municipality of Caluire-et-Cuire" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Caluire-et-Cuire. The listing shows 3 download or service links in CSV, GEOJSON, SHP. The listing shows 2026-06-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
